features.name: any_comment_long_bold_phrase
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain a bolded phrase of 15 or more characters?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads; if missing/malformed return null; empty list -> 0. For each comment string, find markdown bold spans with re.findall(r'\*\*(?=\S)(.+?)(?<=\S)\*\*', text, flags=re.S) (also accept __...__ is NOT used). A span qualifies if len(span.strip()) >= 15 characters. Return 1 if any comment has a qualifying span, else 0. Purely mechanical on raw text; no semantic filtering.

h0: any_comment_long_bold_phrase has no association with delta.
h1: Rows with any_comment_long_bold_phrase=1 have a higher rate of delta (OP view change) than rows with 0.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as OP view change (delta). Bold is detected as markdown **...** in the current comment text; 15+ characters measured on the stripped span inside the markers. Row-level any-comment measure; the hypothesis is about individual comments but no per-comment outcome is supplied, so association is row-level only. Raw text may contain outcome announcements; not outcome-free. Comment timing unknown; rendering/formatting may have been altered in the corpus.
